Review round 3: chunks staged for the same relayer ACCUMULATE (overlapping chunks dedupe on the original rumor id, newest window kept) instead of replacing one another, the drain re-checks the admin and membership gates BEFORE taking the stage so a failed attempt leaves the slice intact, and the live handler drains as soon as a record exists so a record landing mid-slice cannot strand the earlier chunks until the TTL.
